title: Conocé a mi mamá
desc: Meeting doña Elena for the first time
setting: You are at the door with your hands empty and Lucía half a step ahead of you.

steps.speaker: Doña Elena
steps.es: Con que vos sos el famoso.
steps.en: So you are the famous one.

options.es: Mucho gusto, doña Elena. Gracias por recibirme.
options.en: Pleased to meet you, doña Elena. Thank you for having me.
options.feedback: Her name, the doña, and thanks for the invitation. All three land in one sentence.
Correct and small. This is a doorway you only walk through once.
The vos-level greeting to a suegra you have never met. She will not say anything, and she will notice.

steps.speaker: Doña Elena
steps.en: Come in. Sit there. Have you eaten?

options.es: Todavía no, doña. Huele muy bien.
options.en: Not yet, doña. It smells very good.
options.feedback: The right answer is no, whatever the truth is, and you complimented the kitchen without being asked.

options.en: Yes, I have eaten, thank you.
options.feedback: Refusing the plate at a first meeting is refusing more than the plate.
The one sentence that cannot be said at that table.

steps.speaker: Doña Elena
steps.en: And what do you do? What is your work?

options.es: Trabajo en un taller, doña. Soldadura.
options.en: I work in a workshop, doña. Welding.
options.feedback: Plain, exact, no decoration. She is not testing your job, she is testing whether you dress it up.
Vague where she asked for specific. She will ask again in a month.

options.es: Es un poco complicado de explicar.
options.en: It is a bit complicated to explain.
options.feedback: That answer means one of two things and neither of them is good.

steps.speaker: Doña Elena
steps.es: Ajá. ¿Y sus papás saben de mi hija?
steps.en: I see. And do your parents know about my daughter?

options.es: Todavía no, doña, pero se lo voy a decir.
options.en: Not yet, doña, but I am going to tell them.
options.feedback: Honest about where things stand and clear about the intention. That is the whole question she asked.
Softening it will not help. She will ask Lucía afterwards and find out anyway.
In this house, from today, it is not.
